difficulty_reason: For Z -> S finite locally free and X -> S affine, the functor Mor_S(Z, X) is representable by a scheme affine over S. The retained proof is written: cover S by affine opens U_i trivializing the finite locally free algebra Gamma(Z x_S U_i, O), form the subfunctors F_i supported over U_i, and verify the three gluing conditions (2)(a)-(2)(c) of Schemes, lemma glue-functors; condition (2)(a), that F_i is representable by an affine over U_i, is exactly the chapter's preceding finite-free case lemma-hom-from-finite-free-into-affine (trivialization reduces finite locally free to finite free), and the other two conditions are checked by the author as straightforward arguments on the supports. Retained author proof at lines 20178-20190.
